records.name: İstanbul
records.summary: Model estimate (route 3, best-knowledge delta): İstanbul — the whole scene; the Beyoğlu legacy: the district governor's office ordered trans women's apartments on Bayram Street sealed in March 2024; on 18 July 2025 a residential street was blockaded by police with drones and raids (three detained); on 31 July 2025 around 20 trans women were rounded up for identity checks while street, shopping and in cafés, taken to a police station, names recorded and videos filmed ('this is profiling'). Pride has been banned for a ninth consecutive year — 113 detained on 25 June 2023, 46 detained at the 2024 Acıbadem march with judicial controls and travel bans. Scored relative to the national score (0.15) for Turkey.
